answer: World ID's orb has verified 18 million humans across 160 countries: one iris, one ballot. Each ballot here must carry an orb-signed IrisCode, a quill only one hand can hold — the scan hashes to a one-time nullifier, raw image deleted at once, and a second ballot from the same iris fails in one pass. A farm stamping 10,000 ballots off one face dies by that single check: 9,999 duplicates dead, and 10,000 fresh irises means hiring 10,000 strangers, each queueing hours at an orb, $50 a head — $500,000 gone. Like a sonnet, 14 lines and no more — a nebula of fakes collapses into one honest eye.
